name: Fish Prime
tagline: Pure Stockfish 19 at full strength. No gimmicks.

greeting: Hello. I have evaluated your chances.
Ready when you are. I am always ready.
winning: The outcome is no longer in doubt.
win: Good game. Analysis available on request.

name: Gambit Gary
tagline: 1400 · Sacrifices first, asks questions never. Danish Gambit / Stafford Gambit.

greeting: Pawns are a currency, and I'm a big spender!
Care to accept a gift? Several, actually.
capture: I'll take that as a tip.
blunder: Ooh, now THAT was a real gift!
And they say I'm the reckless one.
win: Fortune favours the bold! Good game.
loss: Worth it. Every single pawn. Good game!

name: The Wall
tagline: 2200 · Solid as a rock. London System / Caro-Kann.

greeting: Let's keep things calm and tidy.
I hope you brought a chisel.
blunder: Thank you. I will now consolidate.
winning: Now we trade down and go home.
losing: A crack in the wall. Unusual.
loss: The wall has fallen. Well played.
You found a way through. Respect.

name: Bongcloud Bob
tagline: 1200 · The king leads from the front. Always 1.e4 and 2.Ke2.

greeting: My king needs some fresh air.
Castling is for cowards. Let's walk.
capture: The king takes what the king wants.
blunder: Even my king saw that one coming.
losing: Perhaps the king should have stayed home...
loss: The king will walk again. GG.

name: Knightmare
tagline: 1600 · Loves knights more than is reasonable. Four Knights / Alekhine.

greeting: Bishops are just knights that can't jump.
blunder: You left that square unguarded. My horse noticed.
loss: Back to the stables. Well played.
My horse needs a rest. GG.

name: Pawnzilla
tagline: 1800 · Pawn storms on every board. King's Gambit / Dutch.

greeting: I hope your king likes company.
winning: The pawn wave cannot be stopped!
losing: Some of my pawns got lost...
win: Never underestimate a pawn. Good game!
loss: Pawnzilla retreats to the ocean. GG.

name: Coward Carl
tagline: 1500 · Trades everything, retreats often. Scotch / Petrov.

greeting: Can we just trade everything and go home?
blunder: Oh! Oh no, did you mean that?
losing: Can I offer a draw? Can I?

name: Never-Castle Nelly
tagline: 1700 · Refuses to castle. On principle. Vienna Gambit / Scandinavian.

greeting: Castling is a scam invented by rooks.
My king stays right where he is.
check: Check! Your king should have stayed put too.
blunder: Should have kept your king in the middle.
winning: See? The middle is perfectly safe.
losing: This has nothing to do with castling.
loss: Fine. Maybe castling has SOME uses. Good game.
draw: A draw, and I never castled. Win-win.

name: The Magician
tagline: 2500 · Sharp, forcing, tactical. Evans Gambit / Najdorf.

greeting: Let's take this game into the deep, dark forest.
losing: Every magician has a failed trick...
win: Thank you, you've been a wonderful audience!
loss: You saw through my illusions. Bravo!
The magician bows to you. GG.
draw: A tie. The trick was... sharing.
